_notes: UQM 0.8.0's own lander, recorded by running lander.c's PlanetSide (the warm-up, InitPlanetSide's jitter, the landing, DoPlanetSide under DoInput, the take-off) with drawing and sound stubbed, a clock that each sleep moves on (so every frame takes no time), TFB_Random seeded and the input scripted (tools/extract/golden/lander.c). Code only, no content.

input.steps: [frames, flags], each held for that many of DoPlanetSide's frames (its first call only sets the lander going): 1 left, 2 right, 4 thrust, 8 fire, 16 take off. After the steps the lander takes off. upgrades: 1 IMPROVED_LANDER_SPEED, 2 IMPROVED_LANDER_SHOT. site: planetLoc, in planetside map units.

frames: every ScrollPlanetSide, [phase (L landing, G on the ground, T taking off), x, y (curLanderLoc), facing (0 to 15), offset (landingOffset: how far above its place the lander is drawn, 0 on the ground, null if not drawn), crew aboard the lander, TFB_Random's seed after the frame, the element queue's [x, y, life_span] in order (the lander's bolts)]. crew_left, ship_crew and landers: after PlanetSide returns.
